name: Forearm Plank
description: Hold the body above the floor on the forearms and toes to train trunk stability.

items.content: Place elbows beneath shoulders and forearms parallel.
Brace the abdomen and squeeze the glutes; keep hips in line with shoulders and heels.
Press the floor away without shrugging, and look between the hands.
Keep breathing; lower the knees when the back starts to sag.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Body supported on parallel forearms and toes, elbows beneath shoulders. Head, hips and heels form a straight line, with the face toward the floor.
